# Topology_Evolution_Model

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A formal framework describing how network connections are added, removed, or rewired over time, often guided by growth or adaptation rules. Enables predictive analysis of long-term interconnect behavior in TCC, supporting design of self-organizing and self-healing network fabrics.
